package.name: planner_stub
package.description:
Integration stub for the empty planning_pkg slot. Implements the *minimum* surface so the three-link integration can be exercised end-to-end before the real planner_node lands. Concrete behaviour:
* Subscribes to /task_assignment (scheduler output) + /target_track (perception output, for coordinates TaskAssignment does not carry). * Publishes synthetic /drone_states (DroneStateArray) for the swarm. * Publishes the next-step pose on /drone_state (DroneState) so the scheduler + enclosure loops can be closed.
This is the *integration shim*, not a path planner. Once planning_pkg lands a real planner_node, this stub should be removed and the real node wired in at the same topics.
